pa_sink_name.label: PulseAudio sink
pa_sink_name.description: Select the PulseAudio surround sink to use for multichannel output. This should be a 5.1 or 7.1 profile sink on your sound card.

multichannel_layout.label: Channel layout
multichannel_layout.description: Select the surround layout matching the active profile on your sound card. Must match the PulseAudio sink configuration.

channel_map.label: Channel map
channel_map.description: Channel ordering of the PCM stream delivered by Music Assistant. FLAC/PCM standard is correct for the vast majority of sources. Use DVD/AC3 if center and LFE channels are swapped on playback. Custom allows manual specification as a comma-separated flat index list.

custom_channel_map.label: Custom channel map (index pairs)
custom_channel_map.description: Only used when 'Custom' is selected above. Flat comma-separated indices for each sink pair in order: front_stereo, center_sub, rear_stereo[, side_stereo]. Example FLAC 5.1: 0,1,2,3,4,5  —  DVD 5.1: 0,1,3,2,4,5

sink_front_stereo.label: Front L/R sink
sink_front_stereo.description: PulseAudio stereo sink that plays this channel pair. Leave every pair on Auto-detect to find <prefix>_front_stereo style remap sinks automatically.

sink_center_sub.label: Center / LFE sink
sink_center_sub.description: PulseAudio stereo sink that plays this channel pair. Leave every pair on Auto-detect to find <prefix>_front_stereo style remap sinks automatically.

sink_rear_stereo.label: Rear (5.1 surround) L/R sink
sink_rear_stereo.description: PulseAudio stereo sink that plays this channel pair. Leave every pair on Auto-detect to find <prefix>_front_stereo style remap sinks automatically.

sink_side_stereo.label: Side L/R sink (7.1 only)
sink_side_stereo.description: PulseAudio stereo sink that plays this channel pair. Leave every pair on Auto-detect to find <prefix>_front_stereo style remap sinks automatically.
